coverage.basis: Primary door = the configured homepage (static curl; rendered DOM identical; page cache of 2026-09-07 identical). Its site-wide ticker lists 6 upcoming rows; its body lists 3 cards, each with a full date incl. year and a flyer image. Ticker ∩ cards = 3 (NOLA 9/5, Dallas 9/18, UNDERBEAR 9/18); ticker-only = 3 (DC 10/3, Boston 10/10, UNDERBEAR 10/16) which have no year, no time and no card. publishedEventCount 6 = the ticker. Second door /upcoming-schedule (out of config scope) lists only 4 rows in its 2026 block, 3 of them already past, and none of the 5 later ticker rows — the delta is explained by the page being a stale hand-edited archive (208 dated PAST EVENTS rows from JUNE 22, 2018 to August 18, 2026 sit below it). /furball-events and /copy-of-furball-events are also stale (2023 and a year-less 'Tuesday, January 30'). Ticket pages (ticketleap, eventbrite) confirm the years and 21:00 start times for NOLA and Dallas. All three flyers agree with their cards (day-of-week, date, venue, time). pastListingsPresent is true because of the /upcoming-schedule archive and the homepage season poster (11 past dates); the crawled homepage text itself has no past rows.
